## Install
**Easy / no terminal:** 1. Download `BlindSpot-2.4.9.dmg` below 2. Double-click to mount it 3. Drag **BlindSpot** onto the **Applications** folder 4. Launch it — the app is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple, so it opens normally.
**Homebrew:** ``` brew tap Nainounen/blindspot brew install --cask blindspot ```
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Nainounen/blind-spot/compare/v2.4.8...v2.4.9
